positive_waste_diagnostic_difference: The shared relinker combines two positive same-supplier landfill-service inputs in one native steel record. Their sum is retained, producing one diagnostic instead of two; no treatment sign is flipped.
limitations: Preserve the existing Premise coke-to-hard-coal industrial heat proxy; this does not model coke chemistry, coke fuel production or a native industrial coke furnace.

RER furnace inventory, source capacity, heat grade/pressure, allocation, vintage and regional extrapolation retain unquantified score effects; do not use the small coke stove or infer extra heat conversion.

CPA to CHI is a representative China-centred regional proxy; ERCOT uses the USA region and LBFAC32 the established Europe-without-Switzerland WEU equivalence. Original source labels and coefficients remain.
This is a controlled postprocessed TIAM heat-array test, not a complete real TIAM-UCL NewDatabase run. Ten heat roles, remaining heat/fuel limitations and other registered sector work are unfinished.
The working tree retains pre-existing unrelated edits; this is not a new clean-checkout qualification.
